heard: When our bookshed had lived thirty-five years, he became the father of Shelah, a son in the quiet of the earth, carrying the weight of Sheol. When Shelah had lived thirty years He became the father of Eber A link in the chain of days From Noah down to the Hebrews Sheila, you stand between the stars in the genealogy of faith Connecting the flood to the promise in the long and living age
